x: Cohen, a Cambridge Blue, jumped 21ft. 8ins., Livingstone 19ft. 9ins., while Pollard and Powell, for the Bels, jumped 19ft 2ins and 17ft. 10ins respectively.
Lenny Paul looked good in the "Southern", winning his heat in 10.62, before clocking his season's best of 10.42 in the semi behind Livingstone's 10.27.

A lap later he was well clear of Warmby who then dropped back into the pack to eventually finish 5th. Lobb (33:25) came through to take second spot behind Phil (32:37) with Livingstone of Thurrock third (33:32).
